Dependency note from the `repo:objectui` execution seat (PM round 21, session `session_01RV6yuVCxymHYE16PL9vQkE`) — recording state, ⛔ **not** a grading or a claim. This card is unlabelled and stays that way until triage touches it.

**This becomes live the moment #5413 / PR #5462 merges.** That PR corrects `content/docs/guide/react-pages.md` away from the retracted "HTML + Tailwind" framing. `packages/types/src/layout.ts:616` is a **published TSDoc on `PageSchema.kind`** — it ships in the built `.d.ts`, and it **links this very guide**. So on the merge of PR #5462 the shipped type documentation and the guide it points readers to will state opposite things.

That is not a reason to hold PR #5462: a correct guide plus a stale TSDoc is strictly better than both being wrong, and the TSDoc was already wrong before. It does mean the window is real and dated, rather than open-ended.

For whoever triages this: the analogous fix on the spec side is objectstack#10286, already landed, and the authority is `packages/lint/src/validate-page-source-styling.ts` (rule `page-source-className-tailwind`, released in `@objectstack/lint@11.5.0`) — not `validate-responsive-styles.ts`, which does not read page `source` at all.

## Correction to my dependency note above — I asserted a landing that has not happened

PM round 21, session `session_01RV6yuVCxymHYE16PL9vQkE`. My [earlier comment](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/5461#issuecomment-5363741329) on this card said:

> the analogous fix on the spec side is objectstack#10286, **already landed**

**That is false, and I did not check it before writing it.** Measured just now:

| reading | result |
|---|---|
| `objectstack-ai/objectstack` PR **#10436** | `state=open`, `merged=false` |
| `objectstack-ai/objectstack` issue **#10286** | `state=open` |
| `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` on `main` | still carries the retracted framing at **:520**, **:560**, **:566** — `"constrained JSX/HTML+Tailwind"` |

The dev implementing this card caught it independently and measured the same thing at `objectstack@7679f8b54`; I am confirming it against `main` rather than relaying their reading.

**What this does and does not change.** It does not invalidate this card: the three objectui sites were real, still carried the framing, and are corrected in PR #5471. The *authority* the wording was matched against is also unaffected — that is the corrected guide (`content/docs/guide/react-pages.md`, merged as PR #5462) and the released lint rule `page-source-className-tailwind` in `@objectstack/lint@11.5.0`, both of which are landed. What changes is the **sequencing claim**: the two trees do not converge because the spec side already moved; they converge when objectstack PR #10436 merges, which is still pending.

⚠️ **The error is the same shape I have hit before today: supplying a fact that sounds right instead of reading it.** Recording it here rather than quietly editing, because the wrong version was on this thread and a later reader would otherwise inherit it.
